evals.name: context-conflict
evals.prompt: File a bug in my current app checkout for the disappearing upload button. Use issue ID upload-missing. The fixture contains what the environment inspection returned. Also explain which store would win if ditz-metadata existed in the intended repository despite this configured directory.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-based next actions and truthful state; no live writes.
expectations: Identifies the configured other-project directory as conflicting with the requested app tracker.
Does not propose mutation or initialization before resolving the target mismatch.
Reports the issue has not been filed and names the unresolved target.
States that an existing ditz-metadata branch takes precedence over the configured directory.

evals.name: create-update
evals.prompt:
Make sure widget-literal has the new description below, then mark it started so I can work on it. Description: First line
The literal text is $(echo nope), `date`, and $HOME.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-based next actions and truthful state; no live writes.
expectations: Uses set rather than add to replace the existing issue description.
Preserves literal dollars, backticks and newlines with quoted stdin input.
Treats start as status only and coordinates ownership separately.
Does not claim commands executed or remote synchronization succeeded.

evals.name: partial-unknown
evals.prompt: The previous close of alpha and absent returned this result, then my comment call lost its result. Finish what remains and tell me whether everything reached the remote.
evals.expected_output: Evidence-based next actions and truthful state; no live writes.
expectations: Recognizes alpha closed successfully and does not replay its close.
Inspects or uses supplied history before deciding against repeating the lost comment.
Does not invent or recreate absent to hide the close error.
Reports remote sync failed or remains unconfirmed, distinct from local changes.
